entities.summary: The Hon. Steven Ernest Linares is a Gibraltarian teacher, trade unionist, barrister and former politician affiliated to the Liberal Party of Gibraltar (LPG). He was an MP at the Gibraltar Parliament and as of December 2011 formed part of the Government of Gibraltar as Minister for Sport, Culture, Heritage, Youth, Utilities, Refuse Collection, Fire Service, Civil Contingencies and Postal Services. Since June 2021, Linares was the Minister for Housing, Employment, Youth and Sport. On 19 September 2023, it was announced that he would not stand for re-election, ending his 23 year career as MP and 12 years as Minister.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Minister for Housing, Employment, Youth and Sport from June 2021 to September 2023, Linares contributed to Gibraltar's economic development and social policies. His 23-year career as MP and 12 years as Minister had a lasting impact on the island's politics.
